TarX.Description: Horizontal position (degrees of visual angle, screen center = 0) of the point the participant is expected to be fixating/looking at, sent as an EyeLink MSG at the same timestamp as the corresponding xDAT marker.

TarY.Description: Vertical position (degrees of visual angle, screen center = 0) of the point the participant is expected to be fixating/looking at, sent as an EyeLink MSG at the same timestamp as the corresponding xDAT marker.

xDAT.Description: Trial-phase marker sent to the EyeLink host on each phase transition, recorded as MSG lines in the .asc file. Levels 3 and 4 only occur on test trials (run_type = test); on study trials the stimulus phase (2) is followed directly by the target-location display (5), with no ISI.

Levels.3: ISI onset, return-to-fixation window (test trials only; duration = isi - pretrial_fix)
Levels.4: ISI onset, fixation-hold window, monitored (test trials only; duration = pretrial_fix)
Levels.5: Target-location display onset (study trials) / response-period onset (test trials)
